root_cause.text: The function `amd_pstate_epp_cpu_init()` in the amd-pstate driver fails to free the allocated `cpudata` object when the subsequent call to `amd_pstate_set_epp()` returns an error, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "On failure to set the epp, the function amd_pstate_epp_cpu_init() returns with an error code without freeing the cpudata object that was allocated at the beginning of the function." The patch changes the direct `return ret;` to `goto free_cpudata1;` to ensure deallocation on that error path.
